grok.pulse: Weekend NQ tape leans risk-off into the 6 PM ET reopen: fresh Gulf escalation (tanker hit near Hormuz, Iranian strikes on Bahrain/US base) and Nvidia-scandal fallout (Congress tightening AI-chip export rules) plus a crypto liquidation wave weigh, offset only by Iran-Oman diplomacy and Friday's +2% weekly Nasdaq gain.
grok.bias: risk-off — Hormuz/Bahrain attacks lift oil-spike risk and new AI-chip export curbs hit NVDA/semis 2 days before NVDA AMC, with BTC's $1.9B liquidation flush sapping risk appetite; Iran FM's Oman trip Tue is the only de-escalation offset
items: @FirstSquawk (~7:15 AM ET): UKMTO — Indian authorities report an oil tanker attacked before entering the Strait of Hormuz; CL gap-up risk at reopen — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~6:39 AM ET): Bahrain intercepts Iranian aerial attacks as Tehran says it hit a US base (CNBC) — Bearish NQ

@FirstSquawk (~6:38 AM ET): Congress moves to pass tighter AI-chip export rules after the Nvidia/Huang scandal (FT); WSJ (@unusual_whales ~12:26 AM ET) says SE Asia data centers gave Chinese firms compute and cover for chip smuggling — Bearish NQ (NVDA/SOXX)
@WatcherGuru (~8:04 PM ET Sat): BTC crashed under $63K, reclaimed $65K by ~10:07 PM; X News (~7:20 AM ET) BTC back below $65K on $1.9B liquidations — Bearish NQ (risk appetite, crypto equities)
@FirstSquawk (~7:16 AM ET): Iran FM to visit Oman Tuesday for talks (IRNA) — Mixed NQ (de-escalation hope vs active strikes)
grok.trump: Trump says 'no deal needed' with Iran while allies argue over whether the war restarts (via @unusual_whales ~11:01 PM ET Sat); he earlier told advisers he may pause further Iran strikes unless provoked. US officials say NVDA issues are not on the agenda for next week's Trump–Xi summit.
grok.watch: Sun 6 PM ET CME reopen (gap risk on Hormuz/Bahrain, chip-export bill, BTC); Mon: Fed Chair Warsh 12 PM ET; Tue: Retail Sales 8:30 AM, HD/DIS BMO, NVDA AMC (call 5 PM, first under interim CEO Kress), Iran FM in Oman; Wed: FOMC minutes 2 PM ET, TGT/LOW BMO, PANW AMC; Thu: WMT/BABA BMO, INTU AMC. Watch CL/Brent, 10Y near 5.15%.

reports.pulse: Sunday pulse into the 6 PM ET futures reopen stays mixed: Friday's modest tech fade left S&P at 7561.67 (+2.5% week) and Nasdaq 25136 after the midweek oil-driven rally, but 10Y near 5.15%, fully priced December hike odds, NVDA leadership overhang into Tuesday AMC, and lingering Hormuz/Iran mine risks keep the tape cautious.
reports.bias: mixed — week rebound and earlier oil de-escalation hopes support risk appetite, but hawkish Fed pricing, NVDA interim-CEO earnings uncertainty, Anthropic IPO timing and ongoing Gulf tanker headlines tilt NQ defensive into the reopen
items: @shanaka86 (~7:59 AM ET): Anthropic IPO expected to price $70-78 on Nov 18, trade Nov 19 as ANT; pre-IPO Hyperliquid contract at $101.65 (30% above top) — Mixed NQ (AI IPO catalyst)
@OllieInvesting (~8:00 AM ET): Next week hinges on Tuesday (US retail sales + NVDA AMC) and Wednesday (FOMC minutes) as the key sessions for Nasdaq — Mixed NQ
@KashGodYe (~7:49 AM ET): Friday close S&P -0.4% to 7561.67, Nasdaq -0.91% to 25136.27; week still up but tech lagged on yields and semis — Bearish NQ tilt
@anasalhajji (~7:24 AM ET): Oil market well supplied despite Hormuz tanker attacks; IEA sees surplus as Gulf exports recover, Brent briefly under $90 — Bullish NQ (inflation relief)
@semordnilap0704 (~7:44 AM ET): Week recap S&P +2.51%, Nasdaq +2.27%, NVDA -12.75%; 10Y 5.15%, Dec hike odds >100%; watch NVDA Tue and FOMC mins Wed — Mixed NQ
reports.trump: No fresh market-moving posts overnight; prior signals include possible Iran strike pause and planned Trump-Xi-Putin talks next week at APEC, while Saudi 'disintegrating' comments added Gulf noise earlier.
